refactor(py)!: encapsulate dotpromptz internal modules behind private prefixes (#626)

* refactor(py): make dotpromptz internal modules private and standardize root API surface

- Rename dotpromptz internal modules with leading underscores (_dotprompt.py, _errors.py,
  _helpers.py, _models.py, _parse.py, _picoschema.py, _picoschema_reverse.py, _resolvers.py,
  _typing.py, _util.py, _validate.py).
- Rename internal subpackages to _stores/ and _adapters/.
- Standardize dotpromptz/__init__.py to re-export only the intentional public API surface
  (Dotprompt, DataArgument, PromptData, PromptMetadata, RenderedPrompt, Message, Role,
  Part, TextPart, MediaPart, DataPart, DirStore, DirStoreSync, DirStoreOptions,
  DotpromptError, FrontmatterError, PartialCycleError, ResolverFailedError,
  picoschema_to_json_schema).
- Update tests and documentation to import public symbols from the root package.

* docs(py): polish code samples with numbered steps and inline return annotations

* feat(py): export standard prompt models, store protocols, and tool parts

* feat(py): export idiomatic functions, picoschema alias, and resolver types

* docs(py): target root dotpromptz module for API reference and fix store re-exports

* refactor(py): remove internal package __init__.py files

* chore(py): remove redundant picoschema alias export

* refactor(py): remove dead is_nullable assignment without behavior change

* fix(py): keep published genkit imports working on dotpromptz
